title: How to Explain a Career Gap in an Interview and on Your Resume
seoTitle: How to Explain a Career Gap: Interview Answers and Resume
seoDescription: How to explain a career gap in an interview and on your resume: a simple three-part answer, sample replies for common reasons and resume formats.
excerpt: A career gap rarely costs you a job; an unexplained one can. Use this simple three-part answer, sample replies for layoffs, exam preparation, caregiving and health breaks, and resume formats that show your gap honestly.
